title: WARRANT skill result
description: Result envelope of a skill (07 section 4): findings, proposals, unknowns and decisions of one Run, with `run_state` as the only status. A skill does not judge: the envelope carries no `gate_verdict` and no `evidence_status`. `warrant run submit` stores it as `<state>/runs/<RUN-id>.result.json`, committed with the Run.

run.description: Run id `RUN-<ULID>` the skill worked in.

run_state.description: How the Run of the skill ended: the only status a skill reports (07 section 4).

findings.description: What the skill found; every finding carries its epistemic marker.

id.description: Id of the finding local to this result, for example `F-1`.

marker.description: Epistemic marker (02 section 1): an INFERENCE is never passed off as a FACT.

severity.description: Severity of the finding; `BLOCKER` makes review evidence `NOT_PROVEN` (ADR-0036 section 4).

category.description: Category of the finding named by the skill, for example `missing-boundary`.

statement.description: The finding in one or a few sentences.

targets.description: What the finding is about: stable ids or project paths.

recommendation.description: What the skill recommends doing about the finding.

proposals.description: Proposed edits of artifacts; the skill proposes, it does not edit.

id.description: Id of the proposal local to this result, for example `P-1`.

target.description: Project path of the artifact the edit is for.

unknowns.description: Decision-relevant questions the skill could not answer (02 section 1); stable ids are given by the CLI.

id.description: Id of the unknown local to this result, for example `U-1`.

blocking.description: Whether the question blocks the next transition.

impact.description: What the answer may change, for example `design`.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the skill made instead of asking (02 section 1).

id.description: Id of the assumption local to this result, for example `A-1`.

decisions_required.description: Decisions a human has to take before the work goes on.

id.description: Id of the decision local to this result, for example `D-1`.

artifacts_to_update.description: Artifacts the result makes stale, for example `design.md`.

recommended_operations.description: Operations (04 section 3) the skill recommends next, for example `clarify`.

provenance.description: Where the result comes from: the context the skill saw, the model and the time it worked.

context_hash.description: Hash of the Context Pack the skill worked with.

gate_verdict.description: Not allowed: a skill does not issue a verdict (07 section 4); gates are computed by the CLI.

evidence_status.description: Not allowed: a skill does not issue an evidence status (07 section 4); the CLI derives it when it records evidence.
